settings.title: Settings
settings.deleteSubtitle: All your data will be permanently deleted
settings.deleteStep1: Are you sure you want to delete your account? This cannot be undone — your meals, aliases and settings will be permanently deleted.
settings.deleteStep2: If you signed up with email and password, enter your password below. Type {{confirm}} to confirm.
settings.deletePasswordLabel: Your current password (leave blank if you signed in with Google)
settings.proMemoryDesc: All your meals and food aliases sync instantly in the local SQLite memory.
settings.profileSubtitle: Name, age, height and weight data
settings.goalsSubtitle: Daily kcal, protein, carbs, fat & fiber
settings.feedbackSubtitle: Send a request to the developer
settings.cacheSubtitle: Clears the PWA service worker cache
settings.footerCredit: Emrullah Bayram • Oracle Cloud SQLite Backend
settings.widgetsBody: On your Android device, install Nutrimind PWA on the home screen to open the app with a single tap and quickly scan food or add meals.
settings.feedbackBody: You can email us directly to request a new food memory or app feature.
settings.privacyBody: Your Nutrimind data is stored directly in the encrypted SQLite database on your own Oracle Cloud server. No third-party trackers or ad networks are used.
settings.themeStoredLocally: Theme is stored on this device.
settings.passwordGoogleHint: Leave blank if you only signed in with Google.
settings.passwordSuccess: Your password has been updated. Other device sessions have been signed out.
settings.allowlistEmpty: When the list is empty, signups stay open to everyone. Add the emails of people you want to allow above — anyone not on the list at the moment of signup cannot register.
settings.allowlistGoogleNote: Note: people signing up with Google must also be added to the "Test users" list in Google Cloud Console — Google's own gate is separate. This list is enough for password signups only.
settings.allowlistAdded: "{{email}}" added to the list. This person can now sign up.
settings.allowlistRemoved: "{{email}}" removed from the list. They can no longer sign up.

ai.consentBody: Your photos and meal text are sent to Google Gemini. Data is processed by AI and not stored on our servers.

empty.dayView: Nothing logged for today yet. Example: type "2 eggs, yogurt, bread" — the system remembers.
empty.aliasBody: An alias is a shortcut for foods you use often. E.g. "smoothie" → "1 banana, 1 oatmeal, milk, protein powder". Use "+ Create Recipe" or "+ New Food" to add one.
empty.historyBody: Log meals for a few days, then you'll see 7/30-day trends.

scan.cameraSettingsHint: Open your phone Settings → Apps → Nutrimind → Permissions → Camera to allow access.
scan.cameraUnavailable: Camera is not available in this browser.
scan.cameraFallback: Pick a photo from gallery or enter the barcode manually.
scan.cooldown: Too many requests. Open Food Facts quota is protected — try again in {{seconds}}s.
scan.barcodeNotFound: {{code}} not found in Open Food Facts — you can enter it manually.
scan.title: Camera / Scan

offline.banner: You're offline. Last data: {{time}}. Changes will not be saved.
offline.fetchError: Could not load data ({{error}}). Is the server running?

meal.emptyMemory: No foods in memory. You can add one from the "Manual" tab.
meal.addAsItem: Add this food as an item (multi-ingredient)
meal.basketReview: AI is not sure about this value
meal.aiPromptPlaceholder: e.g. 200g chicken breast and 1 bowl of rice
meal.aiEmpty: AI could not extract a food from this text. Try writing it more clearly.
meal.unsavedEntry: The item you entered has not been added to the list yet. Add it with "+ Add another item to meal" or clear the fields.
